title: CAPN1 promotes the progression of MLL-rearranged acute myeloid leukemia by suppressing SHP-1 and activating MAPK/ERK signaling pathway.
authors: Liu, Jia-Yin; Cao, Xu; Lu, Yan-Ling; Hu, Man-Man; Dou, Yu-Ting; Luo, Shu-Lin; Ji, Ke; Pei, Qing-Yang; Zeng, Ke-Xin; Zheng, You-Guang; Cao, Jiang; Wu, Qing-Yun; Li, Feng
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CAPN1在MLL重排急性髓系白血病中通过抑制SHP-1激活MAPK/ERK通路促进疾病进展，属于纯肿瘤生物学与信号通路研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The MLL-rearranged (MLL-r) acute myeloid leukemia (AML) represents a hematological malignancy with a dismal prognosis and a pressing demand for innovative therapeutic targets. CAPN1 is overexpressed in MLL-r AML and predicts poor prognosis, however, its roles in MLL-r AML remains unclear. METHODS: Prognostic value of CAPN-1 was evaluated using logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses. Roles of CAPN-1 were assessed in MOLM13, MV4-11 and NOMO-1 cells with CAPN-1 knockdown or overexpressed using CCK-8, colony formation, flow cytometry, and CDX mouse models. Mechanistic studies were conducted via RNA sequencing, co-IP, IF and molecular docking, focusing on the CAPN1-SHP-1-MAPK/ERK signaling axis. RESULTS: The expression of CAPN1 was the highest in the MLL-r subtype among different AML subtypes, correlating with adverse clinical outcomes. CAPN1 knockdown markedly suppressed proliferation and clonogenic capacity, induced apoptosis, and caused G2/M arrest, whereas CAPN1 overexpression displayed opposite results, and this pro-leukemic functions were dependent on its proteolytic activity. In vivo, CAPN1 knockdown prolonged survival and reduced leukemic infiltration of mouse in xenograft models, while its overexpression accelerated disease progression. Mechanistically, CAPN1 directly interacted with SHP-1 and reduced its stability via protease function, thereby enhancing MAPK/ERK phosphorylation. Pharmacological reactivation of ERK signaling by ceramide C6 treatment rescued the apoptosis and G2/M arrest induced by CAPN1 knockdown. CONCLUSION: CAPN1 acts as a novel prognostic biomarker and oncogenic driver in MLL-r AML by interacting with and suppressing SHP-1 to activate the MAPK/ERK pathway, highlighting the CAPN1-SHP-1-MAPK/ERK axis as a promising therapeutic target in the MLL-r AML subtype.
abstract_zh: 背景：MLL重排（MLL-r）急性髓系白血病（AML）是一种预后极差的血液恶性肿瘤，迫切需要创新的治疗靶点。CAPN1在MLL-r AML中过表达并预示不良预后，然而其在MLL-r AML中的作用仍不清楚。方法：使用逻辑回归和受试者工作特征（ROC）分析评估CAPN-1的预后价值。在MOLM13、MV4-11和NOMO-1细胞中，通过CAPN-1敲低或过表达，利用CCK-8、集落形成、流式细胞术和CDX小鼠模型评估CAPN-1的作用。机制研究通过RNA测序、co-IP、IF和分子对接进行，聚焦于CAPN1-SHP-1-MAPK/ERK信号轴。结果：在不同AML亚型中，CAPN1表达在MLL-r亚型中最高，并与不良临床结局相关。CAPN1敲低显著抑制增殖和克隆形成能力，诱导凋亡，并导致G2/M期阻滞，而CAPN1过表达则显示相反结果，且这种促白血病功能依赖于其蛋白水解活性。在体内，CAPN1敲低延长了异种移植模型小鼠的生存期并减少了白血病浸润，而其过表达加速了疾病进展。机制上，CAPN1直接与SHP-1相互作用，并通过蛋白酶功能降低其稳定性，从而增强MAPK/ERK磷酸化。通过神经酰胺C6处理药理学激活ERK信号，挽救了CAPN1敲低诱导的凋亡和G2/M期阻滞。结论：CAPN1通过相互作用并抑制SHP-1以激活MAPK/ERK通路，在MLL-r AML中作为新型预后生物标志物和致癌驱动因子，突出CAPN1-SHP-1-MAPK/ERK轴作为MLL-r AML亚型中有前景的治疗靶点。
